parsed.note_claim: Pro-Saudi Yemeni government (PLC) forces retreated or surrendered in Hodeidah and Taiz provinces, including Mokha and Hays, but they are local Yemeni allied fighters rather than Saudi national troops.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: Houthis capture [[Hanish Islands]], [[Hays district|Hays]] and [[Al Khawkhah district]]s in [[Al-Hudaydah Governorate]] and [[Mokha]] and [[Dhubab district]]s in [[Taiz Governorate]]
parsed.reason: The page shows the Houthis captured Hays, Mokha and other districts in Hodeidah and Taiz, and lists PLC Yemeni units as combatants, but the visible text does not mention surrenders or explicitly say the surrendering forces were not Saudi troops.
